assign.request: try to convert doodles to SVGs and use them as decorations, icons, bg, texture, animated?
steps: read the eleven inbox photos and catalogue the doodles

log.msg: catalogued the 11 spreads: 15 doodles make the cut - 12 that recur (star, arrow, check, frame, hook, zigzag, span, diamonds, bowtie, squares, truss, wave) + 3 single drawings (compass, camera, note). 15 native-pixel ref crops cut with headless Chromium; the JPEGs are portrait+EXIF so the crop tool normalises orientation first.

landed: 23 doodles in /notes/doodles/. 20 recur (>=2 across 67 spreads), 3 are single drawings (compass, camera, Heli). Every SVG hand-authored, stroke-only, largest 990 B (heli), total 11.2 KB. Zero console errors at 400/1280/1920/3440, dark and light. Two traps recorded: a star arm drawn with a cubic C curve collapses to a scratch (use Q); the wall column must clear the WHOLE pair or every tile silently overflows its grid track.

links.label: Doodles — the wall, the four uses
Catalogue — every mark, spread by spread

assign.outcome:
**Twenty-three notebook doodles are now SVGs you can call by name.** Sixty-seven photographed spreads read; every mark that is not a letter, a number or punctuation catalogued.

![the wall at 1280](shot-1280.png)

- **[/notes/doodles/](/notes/doodles/)** — the wall: each drawing beside the photograph it came from, then the four uses on one card. Linked from [/notes/](/notes/).
- **[Catalogue](/notes/doodles/catalogue/)** — name, what it is, which spreads, how many. 20 rows recur (at least twice), 3 are single drawings: the compass, the selfie rig, and the Heli.
- **The library** — `doodles.js` (`doodles.star()`, `doodles.compass("6em")`, `texture("star")`), `doodles.css`, `readme.md`, `ref/` (each doodle cut out at native pixels), and one line in `styles/css-scopes.txt`.

**The four uses, all live on the page:** an icon at 1em beside text · a 6em compass faint in a card corner · the star tiled as a `<pattern>` behind a band at 10% · three doodles that draw themselves on in 1.2s and redraw when you point at the card, with reduced motion respected.

**Numbers that agree.** 20 catalogue rows with count ≥ 2 = 20 SVGs, plus the 3 named singles = 23. Every SVG under 1 KB; largest is `heli` at **990 B**, whole library 11.2 KB. Zero console errors at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440, dark and light — [400](shot-400.png) · [1280](shot-1280.png) · [3440](shot-3440.png) · [catalogue](shot-catalogue.png).

**Two traps worth keeping.** A star arm drawn with a cubic `C` curve collapses into a scratch — concave arms want `Q`. And the wall's `--column` has to clear the whole photo-plus-drawing pair, or every tile silently overflows its grid track and the end tiles get sliced.

**Left, with reasons.** Two marks recur and have no SVG: `pill` (a rounded box around a word, six spreads) and `screen` (a device frame, two) — the shape is inseparable from the handwriting inside it, and no crop of either would have been only a drawing. Both are quick to add if a blank one turns up. `/notes/page.js` was not touched: the notes minion owns it and had already named `doodles` in its `children:`.
